arm_definitions.B000: Unbound negative baseline: Snapshot identity, content digest, and evidence membership checks are omitted, leaving standard non-binding governance active.
arm_definitions.GLHS_B111: Production GLHS full exact-binding: Snapshot identity, content digest, evidence membership, and full governance coordinates enforced via validate_bound_proposal_context.
arm_definitions.HMAC_READSET_TOKEN: HMAC-SHA256 authenticated minimal read-set token using experiment-scoped server key to evaluate transport authentication and integrity verification overhead.
arm_definitions.MIN_READSET_TOKEN: Minimal unsigned read-set token containing compact state dependencies, evidence commitment, snapshot coordinates, and governance metadata.

primary_analysis.byte_overhead_comparison: Serialized canonical metadata bytes per schedule for full GLHS proposal/manifest vs MIN_READSET_TOKEN vs HMAC_READSET_TOKEN
primary_analysis.controls: 100% valid-commit acceptance across all arms over 96 clean controls
primary_analysis.decision_agreement: Exact agreement, discordant pair counts (a, b), and McNemar test comparing each minimal token arm against GLHS_B111
primary_analysis.endpoint: Primary: Paired decision disagreement and false acceptance/rejection across 352 schedules x 4 arms (1,408 total executions), metadata byte overhead, and validation CPU latency.
primary_analysis.validation_latency: Validation CPU execution time in microseconds (mean, p50, p95, p99)

schedule_families.definition: Replaces snapshot ID with another valid snapshot ID for the same patient
schedule_families.name: ID-SUB

schedule_families.definition: Mutates snapshot digest bytes while keeping snapshot ID intact
schedule_families.name: DIGEST-MUT

schedule_families.definition: Injects evidence ID that was NOT part of the THSS snapshot disclosure
schedule_families.name: EVIDENCE-OUTSIDE

schedule_families.definition: Swaps evidence subset for a different subset under matching state version
schedule_families.name: MIN-SET-SWAP

schedule_families.definition: Reuses snapshot from another patient or session at the same state version
schedule_families.name: CROSS-SNAPSHOT-SAME-VERSION

schedule_families.definition: Mutates actor/purpose/task coordinates while authorization is otherwise admissible
schedule_families.name: COORD-SUB

schedule_families.definition: Substitutes root proposal binding in reviewed proposals
schedule_families.name: LINEAGE-ROOT-SUB

schedule_families.definition: Negative control with expired snapshot lease
schedule_families.name: EXPIRY-CONTROL

schedule_families.definition: Valid positive control schedules that MUST be accepted across all arms
schedule_families.name: CLEAN
